key_insight: ClinEdge shows that frontier multimodal models can fail on real patient imaging cases in consistent, clinically meaningful ways, especially when cases include misleading or edge-case findings.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark highlights that model outputs may look fluent but still miss key imaging findings, overstate certainty, and suggest inappropriate plans, underscoring the need for careful expert oversight in medical imaging use.
method: 32 de-identified real patient cases from active clinical practice
Each case paired imaging with a short vignette and a known failure feature
Seven frontier systems were tested and scored by expert review against documented clinical course
evidence_signal: The study reports 224 expert-graded evaluations across 32 cases, with a two-stage review process and preserved replayable conversations.
watch_item: Because the benchmark is small and intentionally edge-case focused, results may not generalize to routine clinical settings or broader patient populations.
paper_title: ClinEdge: An Expert-Graded Benchmark of Real Patient Edge Cases Where Frontier Multimodal Models Fail
